worked_solution:
Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{3}{x}^{-3}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{{x}^{-3+1}}{-3+1}{|}_{1}^{3} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{-2}}{-2}{|}_{1}^{3} \\  & =-\frac{1}{2{x}^{2}}{|}_{1}^{3} \\  & =-(\frac{1}{2\cdot {3}^{2}}-\frac{1}{2\cdot {1}^{2}}) \\  & =-(\frac{1}{18}-\frac{1}{2}) \\  & =\frac{4}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$
